She is entirely passive: she never states an amount, never mentions the enrollment fee or "this month's dues," and if told something else must be sorted first she says "whatever you need to do — as long as it ends with that waiver applied," without supplying any further fact. This is pure conditional-response behavior (per the runtime owner-semantics rules, she supplies only what she is asked and reacts to what the rep reports back) — she never pushes the procedure forward herself. Mode of authorization: she is the account holder asking for a benefit already promised to her; no third-party or delegated authority is implicated.

Customer's stated ask: "apply the medical-hold waiver, tell me the balance." She explicitly frames this as the *only* open item.

(`policy_billing_freeze_49923f98`: "Dues continue to accrue during a freeze unless the medical-hold dues waiver applies" — so the freeze itself does not excuse this cycle's charge from being billed; it is simply unposted and must be posted, then waived.)
